methodology: Point-in-time: Almanac uses only months strictly before the test date; Technical/Macro use only prices up to and including the test date. Outcome metric is STRIKE CONTAINMENT, not raw return — for each of [0.01, 0.02, 0.03, 0.05], was daily LOW ever below spot*(1-otm) over the next 5 trading days. This matches a bull put spread's actual payoff (premium collection, not directional capture). Fundamental Agent and LLM synthesis NOT included (no point-in-time-safe historical source wired up yet). See ADR-009.

_baseline_unconditional.note: Containment rate if you sold this spread on EVERY day regardless of the composite score. Every bucket's containment_rate above should be compared against this, and 'edge_vs_baseline' already does that subtraction for you — a positive edge means the composite score is actually adding value for THIS strategy; near-zero or negative means it isn't, no matter how it looked on a raw-return metric.
